Should I delete maintenance records where MCE (Maintenance Cost Efficiency = (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / gencapmw) exceeds a certain value, or should I use a different scoring method? content: What is the specific threshold or criterion for "poor cost efficiency" based on the maintenance cost score? Should I delete maintenance records where MCE (Maintenance Cost Efficiency = (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / gencapmw) exceeds a certain value, or should I use a different scoring method? Also, should I DELETE from the maintenance table directly?

args.sql:
SELECT m.maintregistry, m.maintcostusd, m.cleancostusd, m.replacecostusd, p.gencapmw,
       (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw AS mce
FROM maintenance m
JOIN plant p ON m.powerref = p.growregistry
WHERE (m.maintcostusd + m.cleancostusd + m.replacecostusd) / p.gencapmw > 290
LIMIT 10;

DELETE FROM maintenance
WHERE (maintcostusd + cleancostusd + replacecostusd) / gencapmw > 290;
